_comment: Desk re-shoot of the Hinglish 'Navigating Visa Changes' seminar script (06-16 Oct, Mon-Fri, 1-2 PM, Sydney + Parramatta), English captions. Two takes -> 5 segments; output cuts 10.15 / 14.45 / 18.40 / 25.37, total 28.80s. Presenter: Rahul Dhanda, Director & Registered Migration Agent, PFEC Global Parramatta, MARN 2418640 -- confirmed by the user 2026-10-06 when asked (different setup/grooming from his 2026-10-05 takes).
_language_note: Captioned in English. make_en_transcript.py keeps ElevenLabs' originals as work/<clip>.transcript.hi.json and rewrites work/<clip>.transcript.json: English words keep exact timing, Hindi phrases are translated over their own audio windows. anchor_phrases below match that English.
_face_note: USER BRIEF: no word may land on his face. Measured on work/base_broll.mp4 across all 5 segments: hair top ~38%, chin 56-60% of frame height (seated at a desk, lots of headroom). So every element is placed OUTSIDE 37-62%: captions at 23% (two-line box ends ~31%), badges/highlights ~13-16%, hook banner 235px, poster card ends at ~36%, name card + CTA pill low over the desk (74-85%). The centre-screen hero slam is deliberately NOT used -- it renders at top:50%, i.e. straight across his face. Zoom kept to 4% so the head barely moves up into the caption zone.
_accent_note: Third palette, distinct from both earlier cuts of this script (gold/red English, cyan/navy Hindi): green leads, on navy boxes.

Captions suppressed under it (the band would otherwise sit on the card).

_limiter_note: QA measured -0.5 then -0.9 dBTP at the default 0.79 ceiling: sample peaks sat at the ceiling throughout (dense voice riding the limiter), so AAC inter-sample overshoot pushed true peak over -1. Lowered SFX alone did not fix it.

caption_txt.title: Student Visa Expiring Soon? Come In and Ask — 6–16 October
body: We know many of you have been affected by the recent student visa changes and are feeling stressed — especially if your student visa is about to expire very soon.

From 6 to 16 October, Monday to Friday between 1 PM and 2 PM, come and meet Rahul Dhanda, Director & Registered Migration Agent at PFEC Global Parramatta (MARN 2418640), and our team at our Sydney and Parramatta offices. Ask your questions and we'll help you understand your current situation and the options that may be available to you.

📍 PFEC Global Parramatta — Ground Floor, 1/21 George Street, Parramatta NSW 2150
